s.note: Crisp bacon in buttered soft rolls with brown sauce, wrapped to stay warm.
s.how: Fry 8 thick rashers of bacon until crisp at the edges. Split 4 soft white rolls and butter them generously. Stuff two rashers into each roll with a good squeeze of brown sauce, then wrap tightly in paper so they stay warm until the next drop.

s.n: Corned beef hash with a fried egg
s.note: Corned beef and potato hash fried crisp in patties, a fried egg on each.
s.how: Mash the corned beef roughly with the potatoes and onion, season and shape into 4 patties. Fry the patties in half the oil until crisp on both sides. Fry the eggs in the rest of the oil. Sit an egg on each patty.

m.n: Angel of Verdun chicken and leek pie
m.note: Chicken and leek in a creamy sauce under a golden puff pastry lid.
m.how: Brown the chicken in the butter, then add the leeks and cook until soft. Stir in the flour. Add the stock and cream and simmer until thick. Season and tip into a pie dish to cool a little. Lay the pastry over, trim and brush with beaten egg. Bake at 200C until puffed and golden.

w.note: Warm date sponge under hot butterscotch sauce.
w.how: Soak 200g chopped dates in boiling water with a pinch of bicarb. Cream 60g butter with 150g brown sugar, add 2 eggs, the dates and 175g self-raising flour. Bake at 180C for 35 minutes. Pour over hot sauce of butter, brown sugar and cream and serve with custard.

d.note: Strong black tea stewed in a big pot, sweetened with condensed milk, in metal mugs.
d.how: Brew the tea bags in the boiling water in a big pot until very strong. Stir a tablespoon of condensed milk into each mug and pour the tea over.
